# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` for the project conventions. For AEM block, model, script, or CSS changes, follow the relevant workflow in `.claude/skills/`, starting with `content-driven-development` for implementation work.

This project uses vanilla ES6+ JavaScript for AEM blocks, Tailwind CSS for design-system styling, Preact for reusable design-system components, AEM markup, and Universal Editor JSON. Do not install dependencies or modify vendor files; the project owner manages those separately. Do not assume `styles/src`, `npm run gen`, or `verify:gen` exist here.
